summary: ADV-15 is closed: the helper fails closed and throws on an inline --color-* token declared on the element or an ancestor, and the shipped pricing, contact, and hero surfaces pass with no false throw (25 tests). The orchestrator-directed change of the ADV-15 assertion to expect a throw is sound: a throw is a valid way not to pass silently. One silent pass remains: a colour-token rule injected through a <style> element at test time is not in the compiled-stylesheet scan, so a tested element matching it computes from :root without throwing. ADV-17 routes to Green with a committed failing probe.
blocking_findings: ADV-17 [Blocker] adversarial: the contrast guard scans only the compiled stylesheet once at module load. A temporary probe injected <style> .adv-token-override { --color-slate-900: #ff0000; } and rendered a tested child inside that class; readBackgroundLayer did not throw and the ratio computed from the :root token, the same silent-pass class as ADV-15. Route-to-Green: extend the guard to the document stylesheets present at read time (or hook injected styles), so any rule declaring a --color-* token that a tested element matches throws. The committed probe src/__tests__/contrast-parent-override.adversarial.test.tsx fails its ADV-17 case until the fix lands.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-15 closed: a53d426d5 fails closed. The helper throws, naming tag and property, when a --color-* token is declared inline on the element or an ancestor, and when the element matches a compiled-stylesheet rule outside :root/:host/html that declares such a token; the root token map is the only resolved source.

ADV-18 [Note] adversarial: the compiled-stylesheet rule check calls element.matches(selector) on the tested element only; an ancestor that matches a token rule is not checked (inline ancestor declarations are caught by the inline walk).

ADV-19 [Note] adversarial: the token-rule scan reads top-level postcss nodes; a --color-* declaration nested inside @media or @support in the compiled stylesheet would not be scanned (the shipped theme tokens live at :root, so this is theoretical).
